thread:
zoe: Heads-up — rolled out saffron11b-int4 canary (v0.2.0). Basic evals OK but hit a few OOMs under bursty long-request load.
kai: paste the error?
zoe: short tail from one host:
```
2026-03-24 02:11:08 ERROR allocator: slab allocation failed: need=1.05GB free=780MB
Traceback:
  File \"/srv/serve/worker.py\", line 292, in handle
    kv_cache.reserve(size)
OutOfMemoryError: could not reserve 1100MB
```
zoe: pattern: many parallel requests with prompt_len>600 combined with max_new_tokens=800, microbatch packs to batch=10.
sanjay: sounds like fragmentation due to int4 packing and temp buffers.
kai: quick mitigations: 1) lower model default max_new_tokens to 300, 2) cap microbatch to 6, 3) enable runtime.kv_soft_reserve=1GB for canary.
zoe: flipped those in the canary overrides and ran the long-tail harness for 45m — no OOMs, small P95 increase (~15ms), eval diffs within thresholds.
deploy-bot: applied canary override: max_new_tokens=300, microbatch_max=6, kv_soft_reserve=1073741824.
ops-bot: created ticket ML-1170: \"saffron11b-int4 canary OOMs — allocator telemetry and slab tuning\".
sanjay: add a regression job: 50k long prompts (>=700 tokens) against int4 canaries to ensure soft-evict doesn't regress quality >0.5 ppl.
kai: also add routing rule: if prompt_len>512 AND cluster_load>0.7 -> route to saffron11b-int8 fallback.
zoe: paste override I used:
```
model: saffron11b-int4
overrides:
  defaults.max_new_tokens: 300
  batching.microbatch_max: 6
  runtime.kv_soft_reserve_bytes: 1073741824
  fallback_policy: route-to-saffron11b-int8-on-high-load
```
sanjay: long-term items: instrument allocator histograms, evaluate slab size bump (32->64MB), and add compaction trigger when free_pct<20.
zoe: monitoring window 24h. Will report SLOs and eval dashboard; please comment if you see more OOMs.
